reason: A cross-platform utility plugin that exposes a clipboard_write tool for placing text in the system clipboard through platform clipboard commands.

summaries.zh: 通过系统剪贴板命令将任意文本写入剪贴板，供用户直接粘贴使用。
summaries.en: Writes arbitrary text to the system clipboard through platform-specific clipboard commands for direct user pasting.

capabilities: Writes arbitrary text to the system clipboard
Invokes platform clipboard commands such as pbcopy, clip, xclip, or xsel
Performs an automatic clipboard probe during plugin mounting
Reads clipboard output on macOS for probe comparison
